tooltip.architectstrials.challenge_scrol: Right-click while looking at a block to open a challenge portal there.
Solo: only you can enter, the portal closes behind you.
This scroll is not bound to any challenge.
tooltip.architectstrials.exit_marker: Editor marker: becomes the challenge exit. Walking through its portal completes the run. A redstone signal LOCKS the exit; unpowered it is open. Optional bonus loot table: /architectstrials marker loot_table <id>
tooltip.architectstrials.player_spawn_ma: Editor marker: players entering the challenge spawn here, looking where the arrow points. Replaced by air when the structure is placed.
commands.architectstrials.theme.tp.void_: Careful: challenge dimensions are empty void worlds.
commands.architectstrials.enter.already_: You are already inside an Architect's Trials dimension.
commands.architectstrials.exit.spawn_poi: No entry point stored – sent %s to their spawn point
commands.architectstrials.exit.not_insid: %s is not inside an Architect's Trials dimension.

commands.architectstrials.slot.free.succ: Released slot #%s; it is being cleared.
commands.architectstrials.instance.creat: The structure has no player spawn marker, so nobody can enter this instance.
commands.architectstrials.marker.no_targ: Look at a marker that supports a loot table (e.g. an Exit Marker).

architectstrials.configuration.title: Architect's Trials Configuration
architectstrials.configuration.slotSpaci: Distance in blocks between two challenge instances in the same theme dimension. Only applies to theme dimensions that currently have no instances.
architectstrials.configuration.maxConcur: Maximum number of simultaneous challenge instances per theme dimension. 0 = unlimited.
architectstrials.configuration.structure: Y coordinate the bottom of every challenge structure is placed at.
architectstrials.configuration.portalTim: Seconds an opened, ready challenge portal waits for its player before it collapses. The instance is cleaned up and the scroll drops again with a 50% chance.
architectstrials.configuration.startingR: Rank every player starts with in every theme. A scroll of tier N needs level N or higher. 0 blocks all scrolls until the player receives an upgrade.
message.architectstrials.scroll.rank_too: This scroll requires rank %s – yours is %s. You're not ready for this challenge, yet!
message.architectstrials.scroll.blank: This scroll is not bound to any challenge.
message.architectstrials.scroll.inside_c: Scrolls cannot be used inside Architect's Trials dimensions.
message.architectstrials.scroll.unknown_: The challenge theme %s does not exist on this server.
message.architectstrials.scroll.no_space: Not enough room for a portal here – it needs 1×2 free blocks.
message.architectstrials.scroll.no_targe: Look at a block to open the portal there.
architectstrials.configuration.defaultTi: Time limit in minutes for challenges whose scroll does not define one. Players still inside when it expires are sent back (the run does not count as completed).
message.architectstrials.time.expired: Time is up – you have been sent back. The run does not count as completed.
message.architectstrials.instance.pool_e: No structures are stored for %s tier %s.
message.architectstrials.instance.templa: The structure template %s could not be loaded.
message.architectstrials.instance.too_la: The structure %s is larger than %s×%2$s blocks.
message.architectstrials.instance.no_slo: The maximum number of concurrent challenges for this theme is reached. Try again later.
message.architectstrials.returned_on_log: Your challenge is over – you have been returned.
message.architectstrials.ward.saved: The Dimension Ward saved you from death (%s) and brought you back.
message.architectstrials.challenge_dimen: You cannot sleep or set your spawn point in a challenge dimension
